verses.text: A song of ascents. By David. If the LORD hadn’t been on our side, let Israel say it now,
if the LORD hadn’t been on our side when people rose up against us,
they would’ve swallowed us alive when their anger flared up at us.
The waters would’ve overwhelmed us, and the current would’ve swept over our lives.
Those proud waters would’ve swept right over us.
Bless the LORD, who didn’t hand us over as prey for their teeth.
We got away like a bird from a hunter’s trap. The trap broke, and we got free.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.
